sources: Hits, frames, keys and events: rmxlinux Json/SkillData chr_0024_deepfin_* (game 1.6) as compiled by efsim kit-draft and checked by hand; Json/BuffData buff_chr_0024_deepfin_talent_1_auro, _talent_1, _potential_3; values SkillPatchTable chr_0024_deepfin_*, SkillData defaults for keys the table doesn't set (combo prob_add, prob_max, rate, atk_up, Duration; ultimate hp_tar, atk_up, kill_num); talents and potentials PotentialTalentEffectTable. Batch-3 report docs/kit-batches/batch-3/chr_0024_deepfin.md (mechanics table, kit plan, section Kit).

Talent indices: 0 is Flash-frozen for Freshness (buff_chr_0024_deepfin_talent_1_auro: energy on Solidification and Originium Crystals), 1 is Veteran Angler (sets the combo's prob_add 0.002 / 0.005, prob_max 0.3, rate 10), in CharGrowthTable order.

Potentials: P1 sets the battle skill's potential_1 / potential_1_atb (+10 SP with a consumption); P2 Strength and Intellect +15 (stat panel); P3 the combo's potential_3 (team ATK after a Rare Fin); P4 ultimate cost ×0.85 (loader); P5 the ultimate's potential_5 (×atk_up 1.5 below hp_tar HP).

Element: Physical for every hit but the ultimate (DamageAction damage type 0; the ultimate's is 4, Cryo). Stagger: damage units with damageAttributeType 1 (the skills' poise keys). The finisher's BreakingAttackCalculation multiplier is 1.0 on both hits (no factor).
No log fixture has Alesh, OBJ Edge of Lightness or Finchaser 3.0 (2026-10-20). Hit-stops (combo 0.95 s controlled / 0.3 s, battle skill 0.3 s) aren't modelled (batch-1 Ti1).

buffs.label: Flash-frozen for Freshness: 3 s lockout (timed marker)
buffs.note: CreateTimedMarker 'talent' on Alesh, CD 3 s: a literal because it's a BuffData default of buff_chr_0024_deepfin_talent_1_auro (CD) and the talent table's attached blackboard has only usp / usp_self; the loader doesn't read BuffData defaults into talent values (batch-3 D4, open). All three handlers (his own Solidification, a teammate's, a teammate's Originium Crystals) check and set the same marker: one shared 3 s cooldown.

buffs.label: May the Willing Bite (P3): team ATK after a Rare Fin
buffs.note: Combo frame 93, IfElse potential_3 ≥ 1: CreateBuff buff_chr_0024_deepfin_potential_3 on targetGroupKey team (attribute 2 formulaItem 6: ATK +atk_up 0.15; duration = the combo's Duration 10; stackingType 4: a new one refreshes it, "this effect cannot stack"). After the frame-93 DamageAction.

triggers.note: COMBO TRIGGER (CharGrowthTable chr_0024_deepfin_ComboSkill): "When the Arts Reaction or Originium Crystals of a nearby target is consumed" (game code; conditionId empty). An Arts Reaction removed by a hit before it runs out (consumeStatus). An infliction consumed (his own battle skill) doesn't count.

Interim (batch-3 A7, open; in-game test 63): a Shatter removes Solidification with a physical status, and the engine raises `shatter`, not `statusConsumed`. Hypothesis A (a Shatter counts as consuming the reaction: sk_wpn_lance_0013's "after consuming Solidification" listens to the Solidified tag being removed). Drop this trigger if test 63 says no.

The combo trigger's second half: Originium Crystals (buff_common_originum_frozen, the Endministrator's) consumed, by whichever kit stands for them (batch-3 T2): ended by an action before they ran out, not their expiry (in-game test 71 part 1).

Combo frame 10: SimpleCalcBB prob_max = prob + prob_max and prob_add = prob_add / rate; StoreAttributeValue prob = prob + Intellect (primaryAttributeType 2, attribute 41) × prob_add, useFloor false (continuous, not per full 10 Intellect as the text reads); Probablity(min of the two) → JumpToAction 65, the Rare Fin path (hits at 77 and 93). Otherwise the normal hits at 22 and 38 and the data's unconditional jump 64 → 120. prob 0.1; talent 2 sets prob_add 0.002 / 0.005, prob_max 0.3, rate 10. A chance jump isn't a skill `jumps` entry (Probablity branches: batch-3 D1 open), so it's this trigger, rolled on the battle's chance stream.

buff_chr_0024_deepfin_talent_1_auro abilityEvent 102 (Alesh applies a buff), CheckTimedMarker 'talent', CheckBuffIdInContext checkType 1 tag 1535684437 (Solidified; forced ones too): ObtainCostAction costType 0 usp + usp_self (3 + 6 / 4 + 8), then the marker.
The aura gives buff_chr_0024_deepfin_talent_1 to the teammates (excludeOwner); on a teammate's abilityEvent 102 with the Solidified tag: usp to Alesh (targetSource 1), the same marker on him.

buff_chr_0024_deepfin_talent_1, abilityEvent 102 with CheckBuffIdInContext checkType 0 buff_common_originum_frozen (a teammate applies Originium Crystals: the Endministrator's combo): usp to Alesh, the same marker.

hits.note: atb is 0 at every level; ObtainCostAction atbSourceType 1, only while controlled.
The data's ObtainCostAction has coefficient 0.5 here; atb is 0 anyway.
Mask 2097280 (Final Strike); its stagger unit (poise 17) onlyEnableForMainChar: "As the controlled operator, Final Strike also deals {poise} Stagger".
Mask 128 (not a Final Strike); ObtainCostAction atb 19 (atbSourceType 1) if controlled. 0.62 + 0.62 = the displayed atk_scale_display 1.24.
BreakingAttackCalculation multiplier 1.0; GainBreakingAttackAtb factor 1 (the enemy's finisher SP).
A rotation's dive: a jump, then this landing (batch-1 S10).

Frame 27, in data order: num = the target's Cryo Infliction stacks (SaveBuffStackNumAdvanced tag 1570888476); IfElse potential_1 ≥ 1 → atb_n += potential_1_atb (P1: +10); SwitchAction on num 1–4 → ObtainCostAction atb_1…atb_4 (15 / 25 / 35 / 45; atbSourceType 3, gain method 0: natural; num 0 matches no option: no SP; "can only trigger 1 time"); DamageAction atk_scale + poise (mask 4352); buff_common_obtain_ultimate_sp; ForceSpellStatusAction spellStatusType 2 (Solidification), count = consumedLayer = num, consumedType 2 (Cryo), only if CheckBuffStackNumByTag Cryo ≥ 1. The consumption and the Solidification come after the damage (afterDamage, batch-3 A4); its level is the stacks consumed (batch-3 A3: level {consumed: true}; 0 consumed applies nothing). The SP is judged after them, on the stacks consumed (the data's num, saved before; the same count).

skills.label: Combo skill: Auger Angling
skills.note: Normal path: frames 0–64, then JumpToAction 64 → 120 (unconditional, read from SkillData). Rare Fin path: trigger rare_fin jumps 10 → 65. The jump at frame 0 (no target within 4.5 m → 4) isn't taken. buff_chr_0024_deepfin_combo_camera (f0) is a camera effect.

hits.label: Hook
hits.note: ObtainCostAction atb (15; atbSourceType 3, natural) before the DamageAction (mask 8192).

hits.label: Slam
hits.note: Mask 12288; ObtainCostAction costType 0 usp_normal (10) on hit.

hits.label: Rare Fin: hook
hits.note: Rare Fin path only (skipped by the jump 64 → 120 otherwise).

hits.label: Rare Fin: slam
hits.note: Rare Fin path only. ObtainCostAction atb_sp (10; atbSourceType 0, natural) before the DamageAction; usp_normal; P3's team ATK after it.

Frame 90: SpellInfliction Cryo; IfElse (potential_5 ≥ 1 and CheckHp isRatio < hp_tar) → DamageAction atk_scale × atk_up (1.5), else atk_scale (damage type 4, Cryo; mask 4608) + poise; BlowOff. P5 Mega Lunker Rumors through the scenario's enemy HP (batch-3 N1, enemyHpBelow reads hp_tar, 0.5). Frame 91: ObtainCostAction atb_up × kill_num + atb, at most atb_max (atbSourceType 3, natural): 25; kill_num counts targets defeated in frames 89–91 (EventListenerAction), 0 here (kills deferred: batch-3 N2). On the hit, one frame early.
